title: eludite.workspace.move input
description: Move files and folders into a folder, as Cut and Paste or a drag in the Workspace window does. All or nothing (brief 0073, the workspace-edit applier's rules): every source must exist, no target may exist, nothing moves into itself, and no open document among the touched files may have unsaved changes; otherwise nothing changes and `message` says why. The disk work runs off the UI thread; open tabs follow a rename or move and close on a delete; every language server gets workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles; projects that name the paths in their project file are edited by the host (eludite/project/editItems) and the tree is refreshed.

paths.description: Absolute paths, or relative to the workspace folder.

to.description: The folder to move them into (absolute, or relative to the workspace folder); a project file stands for its folder.
